title: EU Deforestation Regulation: publications and resources
summary: Publications and resources relevant to application of the EU Deforestation Regulation
update: This overview provides links to European Commission resources, and other publications, webinars, and podcasts that help understand how to comply with the EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) and provide practical examples and case studies of the compliance strategies under development. This list will be updated regularly as new information becomes available.
